segments.name: Technology Solutions
segments.description: Duos designs, deploys and operates modular Edge Data Centers, related infrastructure sourcing and fulfillment services, and legacy intelligent technology solutions for enterprise, education, healthcare and public-sector…
segments.evidence: Duos also continues to operate as a technology company which designs, develops, deploys and operates intelligent technology solutions with a focus on software applications and artificial intelligence ("AI") in addition to large project, consulting, implementation and asset management.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for initial Edge Data Center deployments plus long-term recurring colocation and infrastructure services fees, along with project-based sourcing, procurement and fulfillment services.
revenueModel.evidence: These deployments are designed to generate both initial deployment revenue and long-term recurring revenue streams tied to infrastructure utilization and services.

changes.text: During fiscal 2024, the Company significantly expanded its focus from legacy inspection and analytics solutions into deploying modular Edge Data Centers and digital infrastructure.
changes.evidence: During fiscal 2024, the Company significantly expanded its focus on deploying modular EDCs and building a repeatable platform to support distributed compute workloads across education, healthcare, service provider, enterprise, and public sector customers.

changes.text: The Company recently launched Duos Technologies Solutions, an infrastructure solutions business unit complementary to Duos Edge AI.
changes.evidence: In addition to owning and deploying infrastructure, the Company recently launched Duos Technologies Solutions, an infrastructure solutions line of business as a complementary business unit to Duos Edge AI that provides manufacturer-agnostic sourcing, logistics coordination, and fulfillment services.
